title: Curse of Cromwell
html_source:
Cromwell spent only nine months (August 1649 to May 1650) of his eventful life in Ireland, and yet he stands accused here of war crimes, religious persecution and ethnic cleansing on a dramatic scale. The massacre of thousands of soldiers and civilians by the New Model Army at both Drogheda and Wexford in 1649 must rank among the greatest atrocities in Anglo-Irish history,
